spec: bucket_index(value, lo, hi, n) divides the closed interval [lo, hi] into n equal-width buckets and returns the 0-based index of the bucket that value falls into. Bucket i covers [lo + i*width, lo + (i+1)*width) where width = (hi - lo) / n, except that the last bucket (index n-1) is closed on the right so that value == hi returns n-1. Any value strictly less than lo or strictly greater than hi returns -1. The function must raise ValueError if n <= 0 or if lo >= hi. value, lo and hi may be ints or floats; the return value is always an int.
bug_description: The upper boundary value == hi is not clamped into the last bucket, so the function returns n instead of n-1.

spec: round_to_step(x, step) returns the integer x rounded to the nearest integer multiple of step. x is any int (positive, zero, or negative) and step is a positive int. When x is exactly halfway between two multiples, the result rounds toward positive infinity (so round_to_step(15, 10) == 20 and round_to_step(-15, 10) == -10). round_to_step(0, step) is 0, and round_to_step(x, 1) is x. The return value must be an int. The function raises ValueError if step is not a positive int and TypeError if x is not an int.
bug_description: int() truncates toward zero instead of flooring, so negative inputs are rounded toward zero (e.g. -16 becomes -10 instead of -20).
